title.en: One line reaching another through a shared condition
title.zh: 经共之条件一线及于他线

statement.en: In witnesses of two family lines, one line's future reaches the other's along 缘 through a condition its members affect and that feeds the other, under the one and not under the class "a member or not"; through a common source none of them affects, under no relation.
statement.zh: 于二家族之线之见证中：一线成员所影响、而养他线之条件，使一线之未来沿缘及于他线，于一之下而不于「成员与否」之类下；无一成员影响之共源，则于任何关系下皆不及。

laws.en: Two family lines and a condition feeding both: where the members affect it, each a condition of its next state, the line under the one from the first family's first member reaches the second family's member two generations on, through the condition.
laws.zh: 二家族之线与养二者之一条件：成员影响之，各为其次态之缘；自首家首成员，一之下之线经此条件及于次家二代后之成员。

laws.en: Under the class "a member or not", which holds both families' members alike and the condition apart, the line from the first family's first member reaches no member of the second family.
laws.zh: 于「成员与否」之类下（二家成员同类，条件别于成员），自首家首成员之线不及次家之任何成员。

laws.en: Where the members only feed from a condition they do not affect, the line from the first family's first member, under any relation, reaches no member of the second family.
laws.zh: 成员唯受养于其所不影响之条件时，自首家首成员之线，于任何关系下，皆不及次家之任何成员。

hypotheses.en: No axiom; each net supplied: one shared condition, one-step affecting (a member a condition of the condition's next state, no amounts) and one-step feeding (the condition a condition of the next generation of both); discrete steps and equality on the carrier.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；各网为所给：一共之条件，一步之影响（成员为此条件次态之缘，不设量）与一步之养（此条件为二线次代之缘）；离散之步与载体上之相等。

does_not_show.en: That this holds of every net, or that every later member of the other line is reached: the witness gives one pair.
does_not_show.zh: 此于一切网皆然，或他线之每一后来成员皆被及：见证只给一对。

does_not_show.en: That self-concern is held along a class holding the shared condition: the open de se question.
does_not_show.zh: 自之关切沿含共之条件之类而持：未决之 de se 之问。

does_not_show.en: In this net, a class narrower than the one whose line reaches the other family, or a core; amounts and depletion.
does_not_show.zh: 于此网中，较一为窄而其线及于他家之类，或核；量与耗竭。

does_not_show.en: That an actual commons puts those it feeds on the line of whatever acts on it.
does_not_show.zh: 实有之共有物使其所养者在影响之者之线上。

next_delta.en: In this net, a class narrower than the one whose line reaches the other family through the condition, with its core (other nets give such classes: ThirdThing.fixed_class_reaches, the class of being joined, constant, its core continuing the first step; ThirdAffects.finer_class_reaches; FiniteSharedCondition); amounts and depletion.
next_delta.zh: 于此网中，较一为窄、其线经条件及于他家之类，连同其核（他网给此类：ThirdThing.fixed_class_reaches，相连之类，有常，其核续首步；ThirdAffects.finer_class_reaches；FiniteSharedCondition）；量与耗竭。

correspondence.en: PW NOTE §7 item 4: its first alternative answered at the one; its second for a condition the members do not affect.
correspondence.zh: PW NOTE §7 第四项：其第一可能于一之下得答；其第二于成员所不影响之条件得答。

detail.en: «所经不同则不及», by which both negative results are proved.
detail.zh: «所经不同则不及»，二否定之结果皆由之而证。

detail.en: Two family lines that share nothing reach nothing of each other (TwoLines).
detail.zh: 无所共之二家族之线，彼此不相及（TwoLines）。

detail.en: The reach past one's own end along a line under a class.
detail.zh: 沿一类下之线过己之终之所及。

history.en: 25 October 2026: both negative results proved from «所经不同则不及» (GS6, board rule 9, on PF's proposal and its review); affecting_member_step, affecting_member_stays, fed_step and fed_stays replaced by firstFamily, first_left_into_condition and first_never_left, statements unchanged; the next step's general form of the member-class result is that law (Becoming.GrammarPath), not restated for this net, and leaves the next step; does_not_show scoped to this net; study section 404.
history.zh: 2026年10月25日：二否定之结果皆由 «所经不同则不及» 证得（GS6，看板第九条，依 PF 之提议及其审查）；affecting_member_step、affecting_member_stays、fed_step、fed_stays 代以 firstFamily、first_left_into_condition、first_never_left，陈述不变；后续之「成员之类之结果之一般形式」即此律（Becoming.GrammarPath），不于此网重述，故去之；does_not_show 限于此网；研究第 404 节。
